title: Treeplacer - WWOO 1.20.1
description: A (not fully tested) treeplacer addon for William Wyther's Overhauled Overworld. This datapack probably only works for 1.20.1 and (probably) needs the 1.20.1 treeplacer mod to work.
body:
A (not fully tested) treeplacer addon for [William Wyther's Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo).

This datapack probably only works for 1.20.0 - 20.1 and (probably) needs the 1.20.1 [treeplacer](https://modrinth.com/mod/treeplacer) mod to work.

You need to put the zip file into the "datapacks" folder which is located in the "worlds" folder.

I will most definetely not update this datapack. If you really need it updated try some good AI. It will probably manage to, since the datapack structure is pretty simple.
